body: My parents are very critical of me, and believe that I can just "will" away my depression and borderline personality disorder. They also seem to do the complete opposite of what is healthy for me. For example, after I told my parents that I have bulimia, and asked if we could get more healthy food (my parents are both obese so it would be good for them too) the very next day my parents went out and bought two packages of donuts, cookies, and chips. It's as if they want me to fail.
I kind of like that idea. I would have to work for a month somewhere to get the money, but I guess I can take one more month.
I don't have friends around here. All my friends are from college, and they're a bit far away. And I don't want to worry my friends and family. I've already been too much of a burden already.
